p: helping them: Who encouraged them to go forward, and cursed them because they were more careful to build their own houses, than zealous to build the temple of God.
Then said we unto them after: That is, the enemies asked this, as in Ezr 5:10.
eye of their God was upon: His favour and the spirit of strength.
great king of Israel builded and: That is, Solomon.
first year of Cyrus the king: Read Ezr 1:1,2.
treasure house: Meaning in the library or places where lay the register or record of times.
